fieldValues.title: The editor remembers the repositories I open, and keeps my starred ones first
fieldValues.move: On the idle page the editor lists the repositories the person has opened lately, newest first, and lets them star any of them. Starred repositories sit in a Favourites list above Recent and are never dropped; Recent is capped. Choosing an entry reopens it in one click, without the open dialogs. GitHub repositories come first (owner, repo, branch and path are enough to reopen), then a local folder (its handle is kept and permission asked again on click), then a local file. The list lives in the viewer's own browser; it is a convenience and carries no semantics.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Finding a repository the person has never opened (the GitHub and Dropbox pickers, srs-web#425), sharing a favourites list between people or devices, and Dropbox and Drive entries until their handles can be reopened.
fieldValues.falsifier: Once the list exists, the person still reaches their usual repositories through the open dialogs, or the entries fail to reopen.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-10-29 (vignette 'The same few repositories are opened over and over'): "We switch between the same set of repos fairly often. Finding them can sometimes take a while."
fieldValues.return_when: After a starred GitHub repository has been reopened from the idle page in one click.
